correctness.rationale: Frozen RESULT.md ed759eb842e79a069e6ad0120e42823552387488 specifies complex reduced underlying projective variety. Distinct binary-separated row and column weights define a diagonal C* action with exactly mn ambient projective fixed coordinate points. Each r×r permanent is semi-invariant (all terms use selected rows/columns once); every coordinate point lies on vanishing locus for r≥2. The C*-fixed locus of P is exactly these points. Standard algebraic C*-Euler localization χ_c(Y)=χ_c(Y^{C*}) gives mn; projective compactness identifies χ_top and χ_c, while additive χ_c of complement is 0. Checked binary weight uniqueness and all permanent monomial weights for m,n,r=(2,3,2),(3,4,3),(4,4,2) independently; integer-valued checks only supplement the general proof. r=1 would give empty projective locus, rightly excluded.

value.rationale: Euler characteristic is a natural global invariant of geometrically difficult singular/reducible permanental varieties. An exact all-format computation and vanishing of complement χ_c can serve as a consistency constraint even while finer topology remains unknown. Its proof is unusually short and coarse, but the mathematical object/invariant are independently motivated and the all-parameter fact is not a random slice.

final_claim: For any complex projective generic m×n permanental rank variety P_{m,n}^r, 2≤r≤m≤n, ordinary topological Euler characteristic is mn, equal to ambient P^{mn−1}; compact-supported Euler characteristic of complement is zero.
limitations: Strictly complex projective varieties, not arbitrary characteristic or fine scheme invariants
Finite weight/permanent tests corroborate, do not replace, fixed-point proof.
